newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Milwaukee, Wis., $4.5 mln GOs.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Milwaukee, Wis., $4.5 mln GOs.

text.p: The City of Milwaukee, Wisconsin (the City'') wil receive sealed bids up to 11:00 A.M., Central Daylight Time, on
at the Office of the City Comptroller, Room 405, City Hall, Milwaukee, Wisconsin, for the purchase of $4,525,000
principal amount of General Obligation Corporate Purpose Bonds, Series H (Taxable), dated June 15, 1997 (the

Bonds''), at which time and place such bids will be publicly opened. The Bonds will be direct general obligations of the City of Milwaukee, payable from taxes levied on all taxable property within said City, subject to taxation by said City, without limitation as to rate or amount. The Bonds are being issued to provide funds for various corporate purposes of the City. The Bonds shall be issued in registered form in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York. The Bonds shall be of the denominations, bear interest payable at such times, mature in the years and in the amounts and bear such other details as set forth in the Official Notice of Sale referred to herein. The Bonds are subject to prior redemption as provided in the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder complying with the terms of the Official Notice of Sale. The final approving opinion of Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, bond counsel to the City, will be furnished to the
successful bidder without cost. There will also be furnished the usual closing documents, dated as of the date of delivery of and payment for the Bonds, including a
certificate that there is no litigation pending or

threatened affecting the validity of the Bonds. Copies of the Near Final Official Statement and copies of the Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form for the purchase of the Bonds may be obtained from the City Comptroller at the above address, telephone (414) 286-2319 or (414) 286-2301. Reference should be made to the Official Notice of Sale for information related to the Bond details, award, form of bid, good faith deposit, purchase price, right of rejection, security, authority, delivery and CUSIPnumbers. The City Comptroller will furnish supplemental information to any bidder upon request.
